home.title: Ask about data in one sentence
home.tagline: Ask in everyday language. Get an answer, the sources behind it, and what to do next.
home.section.what.title: What this is
home.section.what.desc: A place to ask about datasets, APIs, and access in plain language—not a technical console you have to learn first.
home.section.how.title: What you get when you ask
home.section.how.desc: Each reply leads with an answer, then shows why, then suggests a next step.
home.step.intent.desc: Focus on scope quickly and avoid information overload.
home.step.conclusion.desc: Understand first, then dive into detail.
home.step.sources.desc: See where the answer came from.
home.step.next.desc: Know what to do after you read the reply.
home.section.browse.title: Browse without asking
home.section.browse.desc: You can also open the catalog, sample dishes, or the overview—the same paths work if chat is unavailable.
home.section.trust.title: Trust essentials
home.section.trust.desc: Every reply shows confidence and references.
home.trust.1: Answer first, then data—understand before diving in.
home.trust.3: Next-step suggestions to reduce decision cost.
